title: Characterizing High Bandwidth Flash for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.39131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving requires substantial memory to store model weights and KV caches. As models grow larger and contexts become longer, memory capacity and bandwidth increasingly become bottlenecks for serving performance. Agentic workloads compound this pressure through repeated interactions over growing contexts, making it increasingly important to retain KV state for reuse. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers a way to expand accelerator memory capacity for large language model (LLM) serving, but its access costs and limited write endurance complicate its use. We evaluate HBF for high-throughput agentic serving across system design and scheduling choices to understand when additional capacity improves serving performance and energy efficiency. translated_title: 面向大语言模型服务的高带宽闪存特性分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务需要大量内存来存储模型权重和KV缓存。随着模型规模不断增大、上下文长度不断增加，内存容量和带宽日益成为服务性能的瓶颈。智能体工作负载通过在不断增长的上下文上进行反复交互，进一步加剧了这一压力，使得保留KV状态以供重复使用变得愈发重要。高带宽闪存为扩展大语言模型服务的加速器内存容量提供了一种途径，但其访问成本和有限的写入寿命使其应用变得复杂。我们从系统设计和调度选择的角度评估了HBF在高吞吐量智能体服务中的表现，以了解何时增加的容量能够提升服务性能和能效。我们提出了HBM-HBF-主机分层存储系统和缓冲缓存感知调度方法，并使用基于追踪的仿真来分析它们对性能和能耗的影响。
tldr: 本文提出HBM-HBF-主机三层存储架构与缓冲缓存感知调度机制，系统评估了高带宽闪存在高吞吐量LLM智能体服务中何时能够有效提升服务性能与能效。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an HBM-HBF-host hierarchical storage system with buffered cache-aware scheduling, and systematically characterizes when high-bandwidth flash improves performance and energy efficiency for high-throughput agentic LLM serving.
